status: Proposal only, requires root review/authorization; no runtime driver or policy implemented
hypothesis: A quiet move that creates two disclosed capture threats can force a positive bounded material conversion when individual goal pursuit cannot certify one. Test explicit coercion rather than adding a fork score bonus or increasing generic rollout depth.
architecture: NEW standalone pure public module plus NEW native-template-based entrypoint; existing registered drivers/modules remain untouched. One original native go, then optional replacement; played correction only for an actual override; no extra search in native engine or RNG draws. Parent owns immutable ID, packaging, qualification and matches.
initial_gates: Classic Normal; native choice exists and is quiet; no native immediate terminal win; no current confirmed own-Flag attack (known mobile contact/Scout ray or adjacent moved unknown); at least one legal quiet destination has >=2 adjacent disclosed mobile victims strictly beaten with actor survival, and no legal known/count-possible enemy immediate capture or equal removal of actor after the quiet move. Exact public shuttle and source vacancy included. Gate remains the frozen fork gate; no probing or inferred private identities.
common_control: Evaluate native quiet first, using exactly the same public certificate class as all fork candidates. If native has any strictly positive certificate or terminal-win certificate, keep it. A failed restricted certificate is absence of proof in that class, not proof that native has no better long-term plan. Inconclusive/capped native evaluation also falls back.
certificate_quantifiers: For EVERY count/movement-feasible first enemy public observation, there EXISTS one legal own disclosed surviving capture (ANY own actor), or immediate disclosed Flag win, such that for EVERY feasible second enemy public reply the game is an own terminal win OR fixed-root net material is strictly positive with no own Flag/no-move loss or draw. OR response choices depend only on public first observations; concealed one-step quiet ranks remain grouped. This common response class omits uncertain own attacks and ordinary quiet third-ply moves, so failure is conservative. Capture consequences include friendly losses elsewhere and enemy equal recaptures.
net_unit: Fixed public root native worth vector from campaign_belief_values.worths(lost), summed for ALL enemy casualties minus ALL friendly casualties after root quiet/first enemy/our capture/second enemy. Existing dynamic Miner/Spy worth values are frozen at root for the certificate, explicitly an evaluation unit rather than proof of game value. Observed new witness guarantees15, the native Sergeant value. Terminal Flag wins/no-move wins are separate outcomes, never finite bonuses. If neither side can move, Classic result is draw and cannot certify a win.
selection: After native lacks a positive common certificate, evaluate eligible quiet forks. Choose greatest fully proved worst-case positive net material (forced terminal win ranks first); break ties deterministically by square order. Preserve all native capture choices, terminal wins and every score coefficient; no arbitrary material bonus. If no certified candidate, keep original native choice. A positive bound does not prove superiority to its longer-term plan.
